pr_title: Use ConcurrentDictionary to avoid threading issues
pr_body:
Address various threading issues including:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/104221
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/103823
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/102136

Local testing included running all tests in a loop 300x in both Release and Debug builds.

Linking here other threading issues fixed in this area fixed during 9.0:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/30024
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/92394
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/97179
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/103265
